title: Backend API & AI Integration Engineer
description: We are seeking a backend engineer to lead the integration of large language models into enterprise document processing pipelines. You will build microservices that parse unstructured documents and provide semantic search capabilities.
requirements: The candidate must have strong experience in Python, Django REST Framework, and PostgreSQL. Familiarity with Vector Embeddings, ChromaDB, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is essential. Candidates should know how to containerize applications with Docker, write clean tests using pytest, and deploy to cloud services.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Strong understanding of RESTful API design and JWT authentication
Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines
